rows.measurement_original_summary: Selected CC screen in153 static Δwss populations;139 yielded CC and137 containedC565T.
rows.measurement_unit: Replicate evolved populations; phenotype screen then sequence confirmation.
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Δwss removes cellulose/WS phenotypes; selected CC counts are not common-ancestor W/A/M probabilities.

rows.measurement_original_summary: Fitness comparisons leave at least two alternative nlpD truncations without detected fitness difference from C565T control.
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Failure to detect a difference is not equality of fitness or establishment.

rows.measurement_original_summary: Reporter fluctuation cultures sequenced8 candidate colonies each;60of96 confirmedC565T and6of96 wereA564G.
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Do not treat96 colonies as96 independent culture-level mutation trials; reporter/colony-size selection remains part of observation.

rows.measurement_original_summary: Reported reporter point estimates are4.2e-7 and7.2e-9 mutations per base pair per replication in SBW25 versusΔpsrA.
rows.reported_count_or_denominator: Culture-level mutation model, not fixed-cell recovered successes
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Approximate58-foldratio; native-site transfer, phase dependence, reporter fitness and mutation-model assumptions require independent checks.

rows.measurement_original_summary: Five culture-size regimes cover an estimated100-fold bottleneck gradient;28days,1:50dailytransfer and escalating cefotaxime.
rows.measurement_unit: Parallel evolved populations in two mutator backgrounds.
rows.reported_count_or_denominator: 48 populations per treatment except24 in largest regime
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Population-size labels are not measured route-specific establishment probabilities; different plate formats/volumes may alter context.

rows.measurement_unit: One chosen isolate per selected population.
rows.boundary_for_TMD: MethodsSec12conditions selection on longest-surviving lineages; endpoint isolates are not exclusive first-arrival routes.

rows.measurement_original_summary: Simulation comparison adjusts effective population size downward; the empiricalΔmutH curve still remains offset.
rows.reported_count_or_denominator: Model-derived effective size; no locked external forecast
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Do not describe agreement as prospective held-out prediction or simulations as observations.

rows.measurement_original_summary: Regulatory buffering and detection threshold can produce nonmonotonic detected gain-of-function fractions with plasmid copy number.
rows.measurement_unit: Stochastic simulations and fluorescence experiment interpreted together.
rows.reported_count_or_denominator: Assay gates and cell-level expression distribution
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Genotype production and observed phenotypic mutation are distinct; no numeric W/A/M parameter transfer.

rows.measurement_original_summary: Coding-region versus promoter targets show different copy-number-dependent phenotypic visibility; off-target and high-copy instability exclusions are reported.
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Primary captions disclose exclusions; supplements not downloaded, so no complete excluded-row or off-target audit.

rows.measurement_original_summary: The flow protocol distributes each diluted overnight culture among8wells and acquires at least100000events per sample after regrowth.
rows.reported_count_or_denominator: Cell events within wells; shared founding culture possible
rows.boundary_for_TMD: Eight wells or100000 events do not automatically supply independent founder or known-introduced recovery denominators.
